program.source: export function evaluate({ inputs, time }) { const launchSpeed = inputs.launchSpeed; const gravity = inputs.gravity; const tMax = (2 * launchSpeed) / gravity; const t = sdk.clamp(time, 0, tMax); const tTop = launchSpeed / gravity; const tossedHeight = launchSpeed * t - 0.5 * gravity * t * t; const tossedVelocity = launchSpeed - gravity * t; const tossedAcceleration = -gravity; const isAtTop = t >= tTop; const dropTime = isAtTop ? t - tTop : 0; const dropHeight = isAtTop ? apexHeightCalc(launchSpeed, gravity) - 0.5 * gravity * dropTime * dropTime : apexHeightCalc(launchSpeed, gravity); const dropVelocity = isAtTop ? -gravity * dropTime : 0; const dropAcceleration = isAtTop ? -gravity : 0; function apexHeightCalc(u, g) { return (u * u) / (2 * g); } const apexH = apexHeightCalc(launchSpeed, gravity); const width = 640; const height = 420; const laneW = 280; const laneH = 320; const yBase = 360; const scaleY = 100; function hToPx(h) { return yBase - h * scaleY; } const tossX = 160; const dropX = 480; let tossState = "At launch"; if (t > 0 && t < tTop) tossState = "Rising"; else if (Math.abs(t - tTop) < 0.05) tossState = "At the top"; else if (t > tTop) tossState = "Falling"; let dropState = "Held in place"; if (isAtTop && dropTime < 0.05) dropState = "Just released"; else if (dropTime >= 0.05) dropState = "Falling together"; const panelToss = sdk.panel({ x: 30, y: 50, w: laneW, h: laneH, title: "Toss lane", state: tossState, id: "lane.toss" }); const panelDrop = sdk.panel({ x: 330, y: 50, w: laneW, h: laneH, title: "Drop lane", state: dropState, id: "lane.drop" }); const ballTossY = hToPx(tossedHeight); const ballDropY = hToPx(dropHeight); const ballToss = sdk.circle("ball.toss", tossX, ballTossY, 24, { role: "output" }); const ballDrop = sdk.circle("ball.drop", dropX, ballDropY, 24, { role: "output" }); const vTossVec = sdk.vector("vec.v.toss", { x: tossX - 30, y: ballTossY }, { value: tossedVelocity, direction: "up" }, { scale: 15, label: "v" }); const aTossVec = sdk.vector("vec.a.toss", { x: tossX + 30, y: ballTossY }, { value: tossedAcceleration, direction: "up" }, { scale: 15, label: "a" }); const vDropVec = sdk.vector("vec.v.drop", { x: dropX - 30, y: ballDropY }, { value: dropVelocity, direction: "up" }, { scale: 15, label: "v" }); const aDropVec = sdk.vector("vec.a.drop", { x: dropX + 30, y: ballDropY }, { value: dropAcceleration, direction: "up" }, { scale: 15, label: "a" }); const calloutToss = sdk.callout(tossX - 90, ballTossY - 30, ["v: " + sdk.format(tossedVelocity, 2) + " m/s", "a: " + sdk.format(tossedAcceleration, 1) + " m/s^2"], { id: "callout.toss" }); const calloutDrop = sdk.callout(dropX - 90, ballDropY - 30, ["v: " + sdk.format(dropVelocity, 2) + " m/s", "a: " + sdk.format(dropAcceleration, 1) + " m/s^2"], { id: "callout.drop" }); const gate = sdk.gate("gate", dropX, hToPx(apexH), { open: isAtTop, label: "Apex Gate" }); const objects = [panelToss, panelDrop, gate, ballToss, ballDrop, ...vTossVec, ...aTossVec, ...vDropVec, ...aDropVec, ...calloutToss, ...calloutDrop]; return { frame: { width, height, objects, readouts: [{ id: "tossedVelocity", value: tossedVelocity }, { id: "tossedAcceleration", value: tossedAcceleration }, { id: "dropVelocity", value: dropVelocity }, { id: "dropAcceleration", value: dropAcceleration }] }, quantities: { launchSpeed, gravity, apexTime: tTop, apexHeight: apexH, tossedVelocity, tossedAcceleration, tossedHeight, dropVelocity, dropAcceleration, dropHeight } }; }

manifest.title: Zero velocity isn’t zero acceleration.
manifest.summary: At the top, velocity is zero for an instant, but gravity keeps changing it: a = -g. A release gate drops a second ball at that moment.
manifest.description: Two parallel lanes display a tossed ball and a dropped ball side by side. Each ball features live velocity and acceleration vectors alongside numerical callouts.
assumptions: No air resistance, the same gravity for both balls, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. Pause to compare vectors.
